original_design_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished Chinese social platform video cover, exact 4:3 landscape canvas 1536×1152. Use the two supplied images as actual product-screen supporting inserts, not as the target canvas: image 1 is the real order business dashboard; image 2 is the actual customer value matrix. Preserve their recognizable cream UI, KPI cards, multicolor rings, sidebar, and green bubble chart. They depict a real business software project, not an AI chatbot. The theme is an AI-created product promotional video. Embed the actual dashboard visibly as a coherent complete framed screen, retain its aspect ratio, not a tiny random texture; preserve the main business metric/ring area and important chart shapes. All three approved overlay copy groups must be readable and rendered VERBATIM in Chinese: "广告公司要失业了？" and "AI 一次直出宣传片" and "订单驾驶舱". No additional overlay words, no GPT/model label, no platform logos, no watermark, no fake person, no extra marketing claim. Clean exact typography, heavy professional Chinese sans-serif, generous tracking appropriate to Chinese. Text hierarchy: first phrase largest and attention-grabbing, second phrase about 70% of first, the project name about 45–55% of first and unmistakable beside the product. Give different text levels different colors with excellent contrast. Maintain at least 6% safe margins on all edges, every text group fully inside the canvas. No stretching, accidental clipping, messy random letters, excessive tiny decorations. At thumbnail size both AI promotional film and the named project must be immediately clear.
Art direction B: bright bold design magazine cover, warm ivory paper / cobalt blue / coral-orange, flat graphic typography with tactile fine print grain. Completely different from dark cinematic or neon. Massive charcoal headline spanning top left across most width: "广告公司要失业了？", can break naturally into two lines; highlight "失业了？" with an elegant cobalt blue block and white type. Below a clean coral-orange line "AI 一次直出宣传片". Bottom half contains a large nearly frontal white rounded desktop/browser frame displaying the actual image 1, with slight 8-degree tilt and subtle paper shadow, not extreme perspective. A precise blue pill/title plaque "订单驾驶舱" at the left of the screen, clearly prominent. Behind the main browser, two very restrained overlapping printed interface sheets or video storyboard cards, one containing the actual bubble matrix image 2. Deliberate modern Swiss-style typographic alignment and generous breathing room, huge type, minimal shapes. No robots, no lens flares, no dark background. It should look like a beautifully art-directed editorial cover advertising a surprising hands-on AI case study.
approved_project_name_and_credit_edit:
Edit this existing social video cover. Keep exact 4:3 landscape aspect ratio, preserve its distinct art style, palette, genuine project dashboard and bubble chart inserts, and preserve both hook phrases VERBATIM: "广告公司要失业了？" and "AI 一次直出宣传片". Replace the prominent overlay project-name text "订单驾驶舱" with EXACTLY "个人订单驾驶舱". IMPORTANT: the new project name is a large bold third title, NOT a tiny badge. Make it roughly 80–90% the font height of "AI 一次直出宣传片", with strong contrasting color and clear separation from the real interface. Enlarge or redesign its plaque as needed rather than squeezing seven Chinese characters into the old small box. Prefer a single readable line of the full name. Add a much smaller but legible author-credit line EXACTLY "项目作者：Jed杰德哥" near the project title, around 25–30% its font size; capital J, lower-case e and d, then 杰德哥. No other new text. Keep a clear four-level reading hierarchy: hook largest, AI subtitle second, project title strongly prominent, author credit small. Rebalance spacing to fit all text and both coherent framed product inserts wholly within the canvas; at least 6% safe outer margin for all text and important objects. Do not crop off text, do not cut frame corners at canvas edges, do not cover the main KPI rings with letters. No new people, no logos, no watermarks. Same polished graphic style as the input.
For bright editorial ivory/blue/orange B: fix the previously cropped bottom of the foreground browser. Make it 15–20% smaller and move it so all FOUR corners and complete bottom edge fit inside the canvas with 6% margin. Rear bubble-chart sheet also entirely fits. Reduce headline width slightly for safe horizontal margins. Redesign the large cobalt project-name plaque in the lower area to hold big white "个人订单驾驶舱", then put small dark-blue "项目作者：Jed杰德哥" nearby in visible ivory space. No screen frames extend outside canvas. Keep the strong magazine typography and paper grain.
note: 只保留最终选定 B 风格的来源过程。初稿提示词使用早期短项目名；最终编辑将项目名改为个人订单驾驶舱并加作者署名。其他候选风格不在公开包内。
